stdout_tail:
The analysis ran successfully. Results:

**Finding:** Model family meaningfully affects performance. On a held-out test set, `HistGradientBoosting` (ROC-AUC=0.9311) and `RandomForest` (0.9202) both beat `LogisticRegression` (0.9078). The gap between the best (boosted trees) and worst (linear) family is 0.023 ROC-AUC.

**Stability check:** 5x repeated stratified 5-fold CV (25 folds) confirmed the gap — paired per-fold difference was 0.0226 with a 95% range of [0.0195, 0.0248], entirely positive, so the ranking is robust and not an artifact of one split.

Files written:
- `analysis.py` — full pipeline (shared preprocessing, 3 model families, single split + repeated CV verification)
- `result.json` — structured findings per the requested schema

parsed_result.summary: Yes, model family matters: tree-based ensembles (HistGradientBoosting) clearly outperform linear Logistic Regression on this dataset. On the held-out test set, HistGradientBoosting achieved ROC-AUC=0.9311 vs 0.9078 for Logistic Regression (a gap of 0.0233), and this gap was confirmed stable under repeated cross-validation.
parsed_result.methodological_choices: Target binarized as class=='>50K'. '?' treated as missing and imputed (median for numeric, most-frequent for categorical); one-hot encoding for categoricals, standard scaling for numerics (shared preprocessing pipeline across all models for fairness). Compared 3 model families with light/default hyperparameters (no extensive tuning) representing distinct inductive biases: Logistic Regression (linear), Random Forest (bagged trees, 300 estimators), HistGradientBoostingClassifier (boosted trees). Single stratified 70/15/15 train/val/test split (val unused beyond sanity-checking, since no tuning was done). Primary metric: ROC-AUC (robust to the ~24%/76% class imbalance in this dataset); accuracy and F1 also reported as secondary metrics. No explicit class-imbalance handling (e.g. class_weight) was applied to keep models comparable on equal footing/defaults.
parsed_result.verification_method: 5x repeated stratified 5-fold CV (25 total folds, 5 different random seeds via RepeatedStratifiedKFold) on the combined train+val pool (85% of data), scoring ROC-AUC for all three model families. Compared fold-paired differences between best and worst performing families.
parsed_result.verification_result: Finding held up. Repeated CV: HistGradientBoosting mean ROC-AUC=0.9273 (std=0.0028) vs LogisticRegression mean ROC-AUC=0.9048 (std=0.0037). Paired per-fold gap = 0.0226, 95% range=[0.0195, 0.0248], entirely positive (gap is consistent, not a fluke of one split).
